proof_body:
by
  intro m n _ _ A y β
  set r := A.mulVec β - y with hr
  have key : ∀ d : n → ℝ, (A.mulVec (β + d) - y) ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec (β + d) - y) = r ⬝ᵥ r + 2 * (d ⬝ᵥ A.transpose.mulVec r) + (A.mulVec d) ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec d) := by
    intro d
    have e : A.mulVec (β + d) - y = r + A.mulVec d := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, hr]; abel
    have e2 : d ⬝ᵥ A.transpose.mulVec r = r ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec d := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_transpose, dotProduct_comm, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
    rw [e, e2, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_comm (A.mulVec d) r]
    ring
  have hself : ∀ v : m → ℝ, 0 ≤ v ⬝ᵥ v := fun v => by
    simp only [dotProduct]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
  constructor
  · intro h
    set g := A.transpose.mulVec r with hg
    by_contra hne
    have hself' : 0 ≤ g ⬝ᵥ g := by
      simp only [dotProduct]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
    have hgg : 0 < g ⬝ᵥ g := lt_of_le_of_ne hself' (fun h0 => hne (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp h0.symm))
    set H := A.mulVec g ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec g with hH
    have hH0 : 0 ≤ H := hself _
    set t := (g ⬝ᵥ g) / (H + 1) with ht
    have ht0 : 0 < t := div_pos hgg (by linarith)
    have hk := key ((-t) • g)
    have h1 := h (β + (-t) • g)
    rw [hk, smul_dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul] at h1
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h1
    have h2 : 0 ≤ 2 * (-t * (g ⬝ᵥ g)) + -t * (-t * H) := by linarith
    have h3 : t * H ≤ g ⬝ᵥ g := by
      rw [ht, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
      nlinarith
    nlinarith
  · intro h γ
    have := key (γ - β)
    rw [add_sub_cancel, h] at this
    rw [this]
    simp only [dotProduct_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
    linarith [hself (A.mulVec (γ - β))]
target_source: ∀ (m n : Type*) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (y : m → ℝ) (β : n → ℝ), (∀ γ : n → ℝ, (A.mulVec β - y) ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec β - y) ≤ (A.mulVec γ - y) ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec γ - y)) ↔ A.transpose.mulVec (A.mulVec β - y) = 0
